method: FRW lattice-epoch identification: the lattice source-tensor mixture (f_DM, f_DE) corresponds to the standard Lambda-CDM mixture evaluated at redshift z_lattice. The framework therefore does not need a new dynamical mechanism for cosmological acceleration; the lattice IS the standard mixture at the late-matter / early-DE transition era.

lattice_epoch_identification.interpretation: The lattice source-tensor mixture corresponds exactly to the Lambda-CDM dark-sector composition at z = 0.794, the late-matter / early-DE transition era.

supernova_acceleration.interpretation: z_lattice = 0.794 sits in the same transition era as the supernova acceleration onset z_acc = 0.631 (residual 25.9%). Both mark the late-matter/early-DE crossover.

verdict.framework_solves_acceleration: via standard Lambda-CDM evolution from z_lattice = 0.794 (the lattice encodes the late-matter / early-DE crossover state, not today's universe; FRW evolution from this state to z=0 reproduces observed acceleration via the standard mechanism)
